# Coverage Candidates — automated gap mining

**Date:** 2026-11-08
**Generated by:** `scraper/mine_coverage_gaps.py` (deterministic, zero LLM tokens).
**Inventory groups analyzed:** 275 thin-coverage (make, model, year-band) groups; the top 15 are listed in detail.

**This report PROPOSES entries — nothing edits `UNOBTANIUM_DB` automatically.** Review the evidence, spot-check the sample sold titles, then hand-curate the skeletons you accept into `scraper/junkyard_scraper.py` (with the usual price audit discipline: bands calibrated to sold prices, ceiling rule vs. new parts).

> Inventory-side gap ranking only. No eBay pages are fetched (CLAUDE.md rule 2); price evidence for curated rows comes from the yard price lists and the eBay API feed.
